defined_terms.definition: An event in the supply chain involving a food on the Food Traceability List for which records are required.

obligations.subject: Persons who manufacture, process, pack, or hold foods on the Food Traceability List
obligations.condition: A covered critical tracking event is performed and no exemption applies.
obligations.action: maintain and provide required traceability records
obligations.object: key data elements for the applicable critical tracking event
obligations.required_output: records sufficient to support traceability and FDA-requested sortable export
obligations.deadline: As required by applicable Subpart S recordkeeping and FDA request provisions
obligations.noncompliance_risk: missing audit evidence or incomplete FDA response package

ftl_food_items.description: Leafy greens listed on the FDA Food Traceability List.
form_notes: Requires exact FDA row extraction in deterministic parser before approval.
ftl_food_items.raw_list_text: Food Traceability List Description ... Leafy Greens ...

cte_definitions.definition: Harvesting is a critical tracking event for certain raw agricultural commodities.
trigger_conditions: A raw agricultural commodity on the FTL is harvested.
cte_definitions.output_event_relationship: Provides KDEs to the initial packer when applicable.

kde_requirements.kde_name: Location description for the immediate subsequent recipient
kde_requirements.applies_to: Harvesting KDEs for applicable raw agricultural commodities.

citations.support_text: traceability lot code (TLC) is an integral component

tlc_rules.applies_to_food_scope: Food Traceability List foods when a traceability lot code must be assigned or preserved.
tlc_rules.assignment_rule: Covered records must support identifying the traceability lot code assigned to the food when the rule requires one.
tlc_rules.preservation_rule: Downstream records should preserve the traceability lot code or source reference needed to link the lot through the supply chain.
tlc_rules.source_reference_rule: If the TLC source is not directly available, source-reference fields must support traceback to the TLC source.
tlc_rules.transformation_handling: Transformation events may require linking input TLCs to a new output traceability lot code.
tlc_rules.uniqueness_rule: The TLC should be usable as an identifier for the relevant traceability lot in the operator's records.
tlc_rules.lineage_rule: The TLC must support linking event records across the applicable chain of custody.
unresolved_questions: Exact executable applies-when logic must come from deterministic extraction and reviewer approval.

citations.citation_anchor: Exemptions Relevant to Produce Farms Under the Produce Safety Rule and the Food Traceability Rule
citations.section_ref: Exemptions Relevant to Produce Farms Under the Produce Safety Rule and the Food Traceability Rule

exemption_rules.exemption_type: Produce farm exemption or partial exemption candidate
exemption_rules.eligibility_condition: A produce farm claims an exemption relevant to the Produce Safety Rule or Food Traceability Rule.
decision_questions: Does the entity meet the eligibility conditions?
Is the exemption full, partial, or only modifying requirements?
exemption_rules.reviewer_warning: Do not treat exemption status as approved until reviewed against exact CFR text and entity facts.

traceability_plan_requirements.required_detail: Covered entities must maintain traceability plan information sufficient to explain how required traceability records are maintained.
traceability_plan_requirements.applies_to: Entities covered by 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S unless an exemption applies.
traceability_plan_requirements.update_trigger: Update when recordkeeping procedures, products, locations, systems, or responsible parties change.
traceability_plan_requirements.owner_role: food safety, quality, compliance, or operations owner

sortable_export_fields.source_mapping: Map from receiving event line item, supplier ASN, EDI 856, label, or lot registry.
validation_notes: Required status depends on CTE, food scope, and applicable exemption or source-reference pathway.

scenario_benchmarks.food_scope: Cucumbers on the Food Traceability List

events.event_description: Cucumbers are harvested and associated KDEs are expected for applicable records.
events.expected_tlc_behavior: TLC behavior must be validated by exact scenario extraction.

events.event_description: Customer receives cucumbers and must have receiving evidence for applicable KDEs.
events.expected_tlc_behavior: Receiving record should support lot-level linkage.

expectations.expected_behavior: Scenario parser should produce expected receiving KDEs and flag unresolved assumptions for reviewer approval.
expectations.expected_export_behavior: Sortable export expectation must be derived from approved KDE and export-field records.

open_questions: Exact actors and CTE sequence must be extracted from the complete scenario document in Phase 4.
